blocks.title: THE CLIMB II · 30 MIN · ASCENDING LADDER
blocks.meta: 3 LAPS · 5 STATIONS · 15 RUN LEGS · 2×40 lb · 50 lb · cap 30:00
blocks.format: LADDER · lap 1 = 8 reps per station · lap 2 = 12 · lap 3 = 16 (unilateral: per side is half) · every station exits onto a 0.15 mi leg · one clock · count laps, then time
blocks.workRest: Legs are 0.15 mi flat. LAP 1 legs @ 7.5. LAP 2 legs @ 8.0. LAP 3 legs @ 8.5. Set the lap speed once, leave it.

blocks.noteGreen: Log finish time (goal: under yesterday), RPE, and whether 8.5 held for all five lap-3 legs.
blocks.text: ★ HIGH PULL — hike, snap the hips, elbows high and wide to chest height, bells back down the same path. ★ KICKSTAND RDL — 80% on the front leg, hinge to the shin, hips square. ★ FLOOR PRESS — elbows touch the floor every rep. ★ RUN LEG — step on moving, quick feet, find the stride by the end of the leg.
